body.prepared_from: the rasis occupied by all planets, upagrahas, lagna and special lagnas

styles.name: South Indian style chart
styles.note: A rasi is always at a fixed position

styles.name: North Indian style diamond chart
styles.note: A bhava is always at a fixed position. Lagna, marked "Asc", is always in the same visual area, and the rasi number is written in the box

styles.name: East Indian style Sun chart
styles.note: A rasi is always at a fixed position, as in the South Indian format. Some people draw it with an enclosing rectangle
